name: Rajiel
source:
A homunculus that Forneus made. Although Forneus made her and sees her as a mere tool, Rajiel offers her undying loyalty to him. Rajiel is powerless when it comes to combat, but she can take care of everything else, such as being an operator. She rarely expresses various basic emotions, but when Andrus gets along well with Forneus, she displays jealousy. Rajiel require semen as an energy source to operate and needs to have sex every so often.

「Because I can offer anything and everything to you, Forneus-sama」
